description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class SmsCampaignMustBeClosedToBeDeletedException used within the SMS campaign management domain of the Fineract project. The exception indicates that an SMS campaign cannot be deleted unless it is in the 'Closed' state.
external_methods: super(String code, String defaultMessage, Object resourceId)

classes.name: SmsCampaignMustBeClosedToBeDeletedException
classes.description: A custom exception extending AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException, indicating that the SMS campaign must be in 'Closed' state to be deleted.

methods.name: SmsCampaignMustBeClosedToBeDeletedException
methods.description: Constructor that creates the exception with a specific error message including the resource ID, indicating the campaign cannot be deleted.

calls: super("error.msg.sms.campaign.cannot.be.deleted", "Campaign with identifier " + resourceId + " cannot be deleted as it is not in `Closed` state.", resourceId)
